description: This file defines constants, enums, structures, and function prototypes for managing a wireless DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) state machine related to radio operations.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_init
methods.description: Initializes the DFS state machine with a given radio object.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the DFS state machine for a given radio object.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_start
methods.description: Starts the DFS process, optionally in direct mode.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_stop
methods.description: Stops the DFS process for a given radio object.
